card.name: Allergy words in contraindication lists
card.fires_on: Partway through allergy words like anaphylactic and hypersensitivity, or on 'known' and 'history', in contraindication statements. Also once on 'fell' before 'in love'.

modes.label: Allergy terms
modes.description: Inside anaphylactic or hypersensitivity right where a known reaction is listed as a contraindication.

modes.label: Known history lead-in
modes.description: The words known or history right before a named condition or hypersensitivity in a contraindication.
modes.example: Desmopressin acetate injection is contraindicated in patients with<< known>> hypersensitivity to desmopressin

modes.label: Falling in love
modes.description: The word fell in a story, just before 'in love'.
modes.example: saw her dancing and<< fell>> desperately in love with her

card.writes: It pushes down relationship and love words, so it adds no clear effect on allergy text itself.
card.plain: It fires on allergy wording in lists of reasons not to give a drug, such as known anaphylactic reaction.
